verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Cline runs a hosted gateway (api.cline.bot) with a documented Chat Completions endpoint. Probes found no downloadable machine-readable spec: the candidate OpenAPI paths return 404 on docs.cline.bot and 401 on api.cline.bot, and the endpoint is documented only by reference to OpenAI's format in hand-written MDX pages. The llms.txt documentation index is a docs map, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
